packageRules.description: ci.yml's and semantic-pr.yml's hugoh/go-tools reusable-workflow pins are Copier-owned (regenerated with a version comment on every `copier update`), so keep Renovate's github-actions manager off them to avoid the two racing. Scoped to these files only: a hand-maintained workflow that calls a go-tools reusable workflow (e.g. a repo-specific compat matrix) still gets managed normally.

A go-tools release only reaches a consumer via this Copier-update PR, and go-tools already gates its own releases to fix-worthy template changes (Go toolchain, other mise tool pins, pinned actions). Force `fix` (not the default `chore`) so the fan-out itself also cuts a patch release in the consumer, instead of silently landing as a no-op commit.
mise.ci.toml is NOT Copier-managed (only repos that commit it directly, e.g. for CI-only tools like jj) — let Renovate bump it normally.

Unlike mise.toml, .config/mise/conf.d/go.toml is only Copier-seeded once (_skip_if_exists) and Renovate owns Go version bumps there directly afterward. Tag those bumps `fix` (not the default `chore`) since a Go toolchain bump can carry security/bug fixes, so cocogitto's `cog bump --auto` cuts a patch release for it on its own — independent of go-tools' own release cadence and not bundled with unrelated copier updates.
